claims.value: Human male figure of wood with a fish's mouth. Eyes inlaid with shell and obsidian. A pierced projection at back of neck.
Height: 28.50 centimetres Width: 12 centimetres Depth: 11.75 centimetres

Collected by Adolphe Boucard, and given to the BM by A W Franks on 29 October 1872. It was recorded as having come from the Chincha Islands off Peru, but was regarded as having been made on Easter Island.
